items.statement: The independent investigation attempts all six labeled systems and records case-specific convergence, state identity, geometry/state choice, and validation evidence.
items.expected: Six case-specific records with explicit validation and any failures identified; hypotheses and discrimination are separated from raw observables.

items.statement: The relaxed singlet energies show the reported substituent and solvent pattern.
items.expected: OMe: 2.16 eV hexane and 2.11 eV chloroform; CHO: 2.18 and 2.14 eV; H: 2.20 and 2.16 eV, within tolerance.

items.statement: The triplet energies show little solvent dependence across the three compounds.
items.expected: Values are near 1.27-1.28 eV with small hexane/chloroform spreads: OMe 1.27/1.27, CHO 1.27/1.28, H 1.27/1.27 eV.

items.statement: The calculated singlet is bright and H->L-like while the triplet is dark under the reported no-spin-orbit treatment.
items.expected: The report supplies compatible diagnostics or a justified alternative state-character analysis.
